title: Determinant of (B∘ι_T)*(B∘ι_T) on a subspace T equals the Gram determinant of B on an orthonormal frame of T
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let T be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with the inner product of ℝ^P, let B : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map, and let σ = (σ_0, …, σ_{k−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P with span{σ_0, …, σ_{k−1}} = T. Let ι_T : T → ℝ^P be the inclusion (T.subtypeL) and let * denote the adjoint for the inner products of T and ℝ^P. Then the determinant of the endomorphism (B∘ι_T)*(B∘ι_T) of T equals det[⟨Bσ_i, Bσ_j⟩]_{i,j<k}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (σ : Fin k → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = T → ((B.comp T.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L (B.comp T.subtypeL)).det = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (B (σ i)) (B (σ j)))
